clue.text: Parliamentary report tough on tapping by US agents

indicators.note: tapping is bugging, so the agents get inside the word for tough, listening in on it

parts.note: tough means hard
the NSA is the US National Security Agency

explanation.surface: A news story about American spies bugging Parliament, from the year of the Snowden leaks.
explanation.walkthrough: Hansard is the official printed record of debates in the UK Parliament; the clue's spying theme comes from the 2013 revelations about American surveillance.
explanation.definitionFit: Hansard is the name of the verbatim published record of proceedings in the British Parliament.

clue.text: British detective and US police swapping leads to find source of food adulteration?

parts.note: Inspector Morse, the Oxford TV detective

explanation.walkthrough: In 2013 beef products in Britain were found to contain meat from another animal.
explanation.definitionFit: In the 2013 scandal, equine flesh was the contaminant found passed off as beef in processed foods.

clue.text: Note skilful footballer losing head repeatedly — he's biting!

parts.note: a dribbler runs with the ball past opponents

clue.text: Advanced exam with international sliding scales for calculation?

parts.note: the bac is the baccalaureate exam

explanation.surface: An advanced international exam with grading on a sliding scale.
explanation.definitionFit: Counting frames with beads slid along wires are used for arithmetic, a playful description.

clue.text: Two parties with schemes to start with — but they were never going to fly!

parts.note: a do is a party

indicators.note: to start with means take the opening letter

clue.text: Inappropriately attributing gender to Bradley?

explanation.surface: A comment on how the press handled the US soldier's announcement of her gender in 2013.
explanation.walkthrough: Two readings meet: the surname of the soldier then called Bradley, and 'man-ing', labelling someone male.

clue.text: Successful athlete turned dame on royal's final roll of honour?

final means the last letter of the word royal

parts.note: a roll is a list

explanation.surface: An Olympic star made a dame and placed on the honours list.

clue.text: In Germany, place unity first — recall left and right, leaving out centre in national government

indicators.note: in places these letters inside the abbreviation

indicators.note: first means the opening letter of the word unity

indicators.text: left and right, leaving out centre
indicators.note: only the outer parts are kept, the middle pair dropped

explanation.surface: A political slogan for German unity, recalling left and right but excluding the centre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left and right, leaving out centre' drops EM from REMEMBER, leaving REMBER.
explanation.definitionFit: This Bavarian city is a place in Germany, famous for rallies and the war-crimes trials.

clue.text: Covered, as was late Ray Manzarek

definitions.meaning: Ray Manzarek, who died in 2013, was keyboardist in the Doors, so he was in the Doors

explanation.surface: A tribute to the late Doors keyboardist.
explanation.definitionFit: Being under cover means inside a building, and the musician played in the band the Doors.

clue.text: Greek contraction to have increased

parts.note: GR is a shortening of Greek
to own is to have

explanation.definitionFit: Something that has become larger has expanded, a past participle like 'increased'.

clue.text: Thatcher's ultimate valediction — final parting broadcast

clue.text: Brussels hangouts in which la creme may be found?

clue.text: A politician trapped by 'swivel-eyed type' mockery

MP, Member of Parliament

clue.text: Press trial — writers may be held here

clue.text: Turkish area gripped by national rioting

clue.text: Scotland's independence party leaders take a wee dram?

indicators.note: the leaders of the words are their opening letters

explanation.surface: Scottish nationalist leaders raising a small whisky.
explanation.definitionFit: To drink a small amount of whisky slowly is to taste it in tiny mouthfuls.

clue.text: Monitored, office worker indulged in online bullying

parts.note: a team is a group working together

clue.text: America determined to embrace Iranian leader, creating relaxed atmosphere

a gene is a section of DNA

indicators.note: initially means at the start, so the opening letter of thought

explanation.definitionFit: Richard III was the last king of the royal dynasty that ruled England from 1154 to 1485.

clue.text: Putin revolted by latest couple in homosexual marriage

the last two letters of the word
